batch1.name: Revalidation Copilot - Appraisal Update Batch 1
batch1.subject: Your appraisal paperwork just got easier
batch1.previewText: Import your appraisal form and get AI suggestions
batch1.htmlContent:
Hi,

Appraisal season can mean searching through notes, emails and evidence while trying to complete a form that was never designed for your phone.

Revalidation Copilot now lets you import your employer's appraisal form, tap and fill the boxes directly, and get helpful AI suggestions from your logged CPD, feedback, reflections and shifts.

You stay in control: review, edit and approve every suggestion before saving. Managers can also add feedback, which can be imported back into your revalidation records for review and, where appropriate, used as practice-related feedback.

You can keep evidence linked and export your completed form when you're ready.

It's designed to support the growing connection between workplace appraisal and NMC revalidation, helping you keep your professional development in one place.

Try the new appraisal features today

The Revalidation Copilot team
